summary: Choosing a convention delegation starts another round of work inside the delegation itself.
realLife: The 31st District chair reported in March that the state convention delegation had already met twice and elected its own officers.
inGame: needs: selected delegation and internal election.

turns.pulledBy: The delegation has filled its officer posts.
turns.what: Its representative reports the names to the district.
turns.writesBack: Members know who handles convention business.

turns.pulledBy: The internal election is still pending.
turns.what: The representative reports the open assignments.
turns.writesBack: District officers avoid speaking for a delegation that has not organized.
